title: Differentiator Filter
text: Direct form FIR fullband differentiator filter, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Rounding mode} sets Rounding mode; {Design minimum order filter}, {Filter order} sets the order of differentiator filter, {Maximum passband ripple (dB)}, {Scale filter coefficients}, {View Filter Response}, {Simulate using} and {Coefficients}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Design minimum order filter
params.values: Design minimum order filter on (default) | off

params.name: Filter order
params.values: Order of differentiator filter 31 (default) | odd positive integer

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Simulate using Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero
